title: RPKI now protects 70% of internet routes
summary: RPKI (Resource Public Key Infrastructure) has reached a significant milestone by protecting 70% of all internet routes, marking a major advancement in BGP routing security. This cryptographic framework helps prevent route hijacking attacks and misconfigurations that could redirect internet traffic.
problem_solved: Prevents BGP route hijacking and misconfiguration attacks that could redirect or intercept internet traffic through unauthorized route announcements.
why_valuable: Provides cryptographic validation of internet route ownership, making it nearly impossible for attackers to fraudulently announce routes they don't own and improving overall internet infrastructure security.
